paragraphs: I have been riding since I was seven years old and competing in hunters and jumpers for the past eight years. My passion for the sport drives me to train daily and push my limits at every competition.

I am looking to continue my riding career at the collegiate level while pursuing a degree in Business. I am a dedicated student-athlete who balances academics and athletics with discipline and determination.
